home.title: See how your money habits add up
home.pitch: Arthik reads your bank or mobile-wallet transactions and gives you a financial health score from {lowest} to {highest}, with every point explained.
home.samples.note: Five invented people, each with six months of everyday transactions. Look at a few and you’ll see that the score measures habits, not income.
home.own.title: Your own transactions
home.own.text: Save a statement from your bank or mobile wallet as a CSV file, and Arthik will work out your score the same way.
home.privacy.lead: Your data stays in your browser.
home.privacy.text: Arthik runs entirely in your browser, so your file is never uploaded, and nothing is saved: refresh the page and it’s gone.
home.method.title: What goes into the score
home.method.note: Five measures of your money habits, each scored out of {highest}. Some count for more than others.
home.method.formulas: The score is worked out with published formulas, not by AI, so every point can be traced back to your own numbers.
